mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, phone, update_date, create_date FROM "user" ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, address, phone, update_date, create_date FROM "user" WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "user" ( name, address, phone, update_date, create_date ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{update_date}, #{create_date} )
